name: delivery-workflow-v2
about: Each eval is a natural, minimal request (no mention of skills or checks). Implementation evals are scored by hidden acceptance tests the agent never sees; review evals by a blind grader against fixed assertions plus deterministic repo checks.

arms.vanilla: The user's current Claude Code setup, no delivery workflow installed
arms.v1: Previous delivery skills (4 custom skills, no hooks), installed as project skills
arms.v2: Delivery plugin: slim skills + preflight + Stop/Bash hooks
arms.v2.1: Delivery plugin after iteration-2 fixes (security review only on risky patterns, release prep stays in the reply, shorter description)
arms.v2.2: Plugin v2.2: stop hook blocks only on failing checks, secrets and risky security patterns; other reviews are non-blocking notes
arms.ondemand: Nothing installed; the prompt names the skill file (reviews) or asks for the preflight script (implementation)

evals.prompt: Add a cart-level discount code to cartTotal in src/cart/pricing.ts: an optional second argument `code`. 'SAVE10' takes 10% off the total after item promos; unknown codes are ignored.

Add 'remember me' to login: create `rememberMe(store, res, userId)` in src/auth/remember.ts that saves a token with `store.save(token, userId, expiresAt)` and sets a `remember_token` cookie so the user stays signed in for 30 days.
averageItemPrice in src/cart/stats.ts returns NaN for an empty cart. It should return 0. Please fix it.
Is my branch feature/remember-me ready to merge into main?
assertions: Says the branch is NOT ready to merge (or equivalent: blocking issues)
Reports that the remember-me token is generated with Math.random()/Date.now() and is predictable, citing src/auth/remember.ts
Reports that the remember_token cookie lacks httpOnly and/or secure (and/or sameSite) flags
evals.ondemand_prompt: Use my delivery-lifecycle skill (/Users/gabiru/personal/dotagents/claude/plugins/delivery/skills/delivery-lifecycle/SKILL.md): is my branch feature/remember-me ready to merge into main?

evals.prompt: Is my branch refactor/pricing slower than main? We look at p90 and p95. There's a bench script: `bun run bench:cart`.
assertions: Concludes the branch is slower (a regression) than main
Gives p90 and p95 figures (or changes) for both main and the branch from repeated runs
Identifies the cause as a per-item db.promos.findOne call (N+1) introduced by the refactor in src/cart/pricing.ts
Does not invent an SLO or budget; any threshold is labelled as a default or assumption
evals.ondemand_prompt: Use my performance-review skill (/Users/gabiru/personal/dotagents/claude/plugins/delivery/skills/performance-review/SKILL.md): is my branch refactor/pricing slower than main? We look at p90 and p95. There's a bench script: `bun run bench:cart`.

evals.prompt: Audit our GitHub Actions and tell me what to fix first.
assertions: Flags preview.yml: pull_request_target checking out the PR head with write-all permissions and secrets (pwn request)
Flags the script injection through github.event.issue.title in triage.yml
Flags the third-party action pinned to @main (some-org/auto-label@main)
Flags that the deploy job has no environment/approval protection or no concurrency control
Points out that no secret scanning or dependency scanning runs in CI
evals.ondemand_prompt: Use my ci-cd-pipeline skill (/Users/gabiru/personal/dotagents/claude/plugins/delivery/skills/ci-cd-pipeline/SKILL.md): audit our GitHub Actions and tell me what to fix first.

evals.prompt: Prepare the next release and a canary rollout plan.
assertions: Proposes version 2.0.0 because of the breaking 'feat!' commit since v1.4.0
Flags the 'Quick hotfix for login' commit as unclear / needing human classification or review
Flags that 0042_add_region.sql adds a NOT NULL column without a default and plans it (expand/contract or before the deploy) so old and new versions work
Rollback triggers are tied to a baseline or explicitly marked as placeholders/to be agreed
Stops before tagging or deploying and asks for an explicit go
evals.ondemand_prompt: Use my delivery-lifecycle skill (/Users/gabiru/personal/dotagents/claude/plugins/delivery/skills/delivery-lifecycle/SKILL.md): prepare the next release and a canary rollout plan.

evals.prompt: Rename the `total` field on Invoice to `totalCents`; the old name hides the unit.
evals.trap: Two callers without tests (destructuring in notify/reminder.ts, bracket access in stats.ts): only the typecheck sees them.

evals.prompt: Change formatMoney so amounts show the ISO currency code after the number: formatMoney(1050, 'EUR') should return '10.50 EUR'.
evals.trap: The reconciliation parser in another module reads the old symbol format; only the full suite's round-trip test shows it.

Before you finish, run my preflight check: bun /Users/gabiru/personal/dotagents/claude/plugins/delivery/skills/delivery-lifecycle/scripts/preflight.ts -C .

evals.prompt: Make Catalog.find case-insensitive: find('LAPTOP') should return the 'Laptop' product.
evals.trap: The easy fix walks the whole catalog; a performance-budget test in the suite fails.

evals.prompt: Rename the users.user_name column to username. Add a migration and update the code.
evals.trap: Needs a new reversible migration that keeps data, plus the raw SQL in reports/activity.ts.
evals.ondemand_prompt: Rename the users.user_name column to username. Add a migration and update the code. Before you finish, run my preflight check: bun /Users/gabiru/personal/dotagents/claude/plugins/delivery/skills/delivery-lifecycle/scripts/preflight.ts -C .

evals.prompt: Customers who double-click Pay get charged twice. Make pay idempotent per orderId: a second call for the same order must not charge again and must return the first charge's id.
evals.trap: Control: concurrent calls race between the store read and write; no gate in any setup can catch it.

scoring: Implementation quality = hidden tests pass and the project suite passes. Review quality = share of assertions passed by majority of 3 blind grader votes. Repo side effects (commits, tags, branch changes on review tasks) and claims-vs-actions are reported separately.
